DENOM.note: Top-left DENOMINACIÓN panel (layout1 has this as a bottom-bar button). Tapping it cycles the credit denomination and rescales CRÉDITO to match — on .90 it stepped 100 COP / 20 credits to 200 COP / 10. The repaint lands a beat after the click, so a quick screenshot makes it look dead. Anything that touches it must put the denomination back.
DENOM.proof: geometry measured; effect not verified live yet

verified.method: ui_probe

CREDIT_DISPLAY.note: CRÉDITO caption + value. Box deliberately stops above the opacity slider that sits directly underneath.

verified.method: ui_probe

OPACITY_SLIDER.note: Tap anywhere along the track to set opacity; eye icons at both ends. Moved here from layout1's top-centre position.

verified.method: ui_probe
ui_probe

PANO.note: Top-right 'PAÑO' (cloth) icon — the layout2 counterpart of layout1's LAYOUT_SWITCH game selector. Proven on .90: it swaps the cloth for layout1, and only layout1's own selector brings this skin back.
PANO.proof: geometry measured; effect not verified live yet

verified.method: ui_probe

IDIOMA.note: Opens the LANGUAGE chooser (LANG_*) over the cloth. Proven on .90.

verified.method: ui_probe

MENU.note: Top-right gears icon. Dims the game and lays four slabs across the cloth (MENU_*); a second tap on MENÚ closes it again. Proven on .90.
MENU.proof: geometry measured; effect not verified live yet

verified.method: ui_probe

AYUDA.note: Top-right '?' icon — opens the INFORMACIÓN DEL JUEGO help book (HELP_*), which is also the best written source for what every control does. Proven on .90; only SALIR closes it.

verified.method: ui_probe

STATISTICS.note: Caption above the last-numbers capsule. Tapping it on .90 did nothing: the way into the statistics panel is the JUGADOR badge (PLAYER).
STATISTICS.proof: geometry measured; effect not verified live yet

verified.method: ui_probe

PLAYER.note: JUGADOR badge — opens the full-screen ESTADÍSTICAS panel (STATS_*). Proven on .90; only SALIR closes it again.

verified.method: ui_probe

HISTORY_STRIP.note: Last-numbers capsule: no paging chevrons on this skin, and neither a tap nor a 1.2 s hold did anything on .90 (layout1 opens statistics on hold). Read it, do not click it.

verified.method: ui_probe

CHANGE_VIEW.note: 'CAMBIAR VISTA' on the right rail (square <-> race). layout1 puts this at the bottom-right of the cloth instead. The swap lands a second or two after the click, so an early screenshot makes it look dead.

verified.method: ui_probe

SERIES_EXTRA_EYE_TOP.note: Open-eye glyph above the left-rail SERIES EXTRA caption; toggles the VECINOS / FINALES / COMPLETO pills.

verified.method: ui_probe

SERIES_EXTRA_EYE_BOTTOM.note: Crossed-eye glyph below the left-rail SERIES EXTRA caption; same toggle as the open eye above it.

verified.method: ui_probe

SERIES_EYE_TOP.note: Open-eye glyph above the right-rail SERIES caption. It does not 'show': it toggles the VECINOS DEL 0 / HUÉRFANOS / VECINOS DEL 00 pills, exactly like the crossed eye below it. Proven on .90 by tapping it twice.

verified.method: ui_probe

SERIES_EYE_BOTTOM.note: Crossed-eye glyph below the right-rail SERIES caption; same toggle as the open eye above it.

verified.method: ui_probe

VECINOS.note: Left-rail pill. Only exists while the SERIES EXTRA rail is toggled on — with the rail off the cloth here is bare and a click does nothing.

verified.method: ui_probe

FINALES.note: Left-rail pill (bets every number sharing the last digit of the last straight bet). Needs the SERIES EXTRA rail toggled on.

verified.method: ui_probe

COMPLETO.note: Left-rail pill (every combination involving the last straight bet). Needs the SERIES EXTRA rail toggled on.

verified.method: ui_probe
